source_text: Convvivium die ablactationis. Vidit Sara filium Agar ludentem — persecutio spiritalis secundum Paulum.
pass_a_gloss: Banquet on-day of-weaning. Saw Sarah son of-Hagar playing — persecution spiritual according-to Paul.
